question.en: Does an observed higher-order behavior imply a mechanism at the same interaction order?
question.zh: 观察到高阶行为，就意味着存在同阶的相互作用机制吗？

heading.en: Separate observed behavior from its mechanism
heading.zh: 区分行为表现与生成机制

text.en: The abstract describes cross-order behavioral signatures that can appear without a direct mechanism at that order. I recommend it as a concrete example of why inferring interactions from observed dynamics requires care.
text.zh: 文章研究跨阶诱导行为：某一阶上的行为信号，可能在没有该阶直接作用机制时出现。我推荐它，是因为这一具体案例提醒我们，从观测动力学推断相互作用阶数时需要谨慎。

heading.zh: 给出可比较的识别思路

text.en: The study compares information-theoretic measures in a simplicial SIS contagion model. Synergy is reported as the most reliable indicator of mechanism order among the tested measures. That makes the paper a useful starting point for choosing and evaluating inference statistics.
text.zh: 研究在单纯形 SIS 传播模型中比较信息论指标；在其测试的指标中，协同信息最可靠地识别真实机制所在的阶数。这为选择和评估推断统计量提供了一个值得进一步核查的起点。

heading.en: Bring a sharper question to your own research
heading.zh: 带着更明确的问题回到自己的研究

text.en: For researchers working on higher-order networks, its value is the distinction between detecting a behavioral signature and identifying a generating mechanism. When reading the full paper, I would check how this distinction depends on the model, parameters and observation scheme.
text.zh: 对高阶网络研究者而言，它的启发在于区分“检测到了某种行为信号”与“识别出了生成机制”。阅读全文时，我会重点检查这种区分对模型、参数和观测方式的依赖。

audience.en: Researchers in higher-order networks, contagion dynamics and network inference.
audience.zh: 高阶网络、传播动力学和网络推断研究者。

reading_caveat.en: Based on a rereading of the identity-matched explicit abstract and the saved assessment. The reported findings apply to the model and comparisons described there. The full text, algorithms and numerical results have not been independently reviewed or verified.
reading_caveat.zh: 依据回读的身份匹配明确摘要及已保存审核记录。研究结果限于摘要报告的模型与比较范围；未审读全文，也未独立验证算法或数值结果。推荐理由中的阅读价值判断属于 AI 的编辑意见。

question.zh: 看起来相似的簇振荡，真的是同一条分岔路径吗？
question.en: Do similar-looking cluster oscillations follow the same bifurcation route?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把复杂的簇同步现象拆成可检验的分岔问题：呼吸与旋转呼吸看似相近，却往往有不同的形成路径。
值得带走的是它的验证顺序：先降维找轨道，再回到全网络检验稳定性，最后检查吸引域。做同步研究时，这套思路比只展示漂亮的时间序列更有帮助。
en: Today’s pick turns complex cluster motion into testable bifurcation questions: breathing and rotobreathing look related, yet often have distinct origins.

Borrow its validation sequence: reduce the model to locate orbits, check stability in the full network, then examine attraction basins. This provides a practical route from observing synchronization to understanding its mechanism.

heading.zh: 降维后补查横向稳定性

text.zh: 簇间轨道稳定，不等于簇内扰动稳定。第 III B 节的模态分块同时检查两者，可借鉴到簇同步分析。
text.en: A stable intercluster orbit can still have unstable intracluster modes. Section III B checks both through a block decomposition useful for cluster synchronization.

heading.zh: 区分存在边界与稳定边界

text.zh: 图 2 延拓稳定与不稳定分支；轨道消失和观测状态切换分开解释，避免把吸引子跳变当作连续演化。
text.en: Figure 2 follows stable and unstable branches. Distinguish orbit termination from attractor switching before interpreting an observed transition as smooth evolution.

heading.zh: 用吸引域与规模对照验证

text.zh: 多初值统计及奇偶规模对照检验状态是否容易出现。局部稳定、吸引域大小和规模适用性应分别报告。
text.en: Random initial conditions and odd-versus-even size comparisons test accessibility. Report local stability, basin size and size dependence separately.

audience.zh: 网络同步、簇动力学与分岔分析研究者。

fulltext_review.title: Missing links prediction: Comparing machine learning with physics-rooted approaches

question.zh: 相同信息条件下，复杂模型能带来多少额外收益？
question.en: With the same information, how much does a more complex model gain?

zh: 今天选它，因为缺失边预测是网络研究中的常见问题，而这篇论文把模型比较的起点放在“双方究竟看到了什么信息”上。对齐信息后，简单、可解释的网络模型也可能具有竞争力。
值得复用的是比较协议：先对齐可观测特征，再改变缺边采样方式，最后同时检查预测质量和计算成本。这套思路能帮助我们判断，性能提升究竟来自模型，还是来自信息与评价设置。
en: Today’s pick addresses a common network problem: predicting missing links. Its useful starting point is what information each model can see. Once that information is aligned, simple, interpretable network models can be competitive.

Borrow its comparison protocol: match observable features, vary the missing-edge sampling scheme, and report prediction quality alongside computational cost. This helps distinguish gains from the model from gains due to information or evaluation choices.

text.zh: 度与结构特征从观测网络计算，再按相同特征组比较。做重构基准时，避免把完整网络的真实度泄漏给模型。
text.en: Compute degrees and structural features from the observed network, then compare matched feature groups. Avoid leaking true degrees from the complete network into reconstruction benchmarks.

text.zh: 均匀删边更容易涉及高度节点。附录 D 改变采样机制后，各方法表现均下降，提醒我们检验结论对缺失机制的依赖。
text.en: Uniform edge removal more often involves high-degree nodes. In Appendix D, alternative sampling lowers performance across methods: test how conclusions depend on the missingness mechanism.

text.zh: 稀疏网络中，AUROC 与 AUPRC 可能给出不同印象。附录 B、E–F 分别检查指标、计算与统计比较，避免只凭单一分数选模型。
text.en: AUROC and AUPRC can give different impressions on sparse networks. Appendices B, E-F examine metrics, computation and statistical comparisons; avoid selecting models from one score alone.

audience.zh: 网络推断、链路预测与模型基准比较研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network inference, link prediction and model benchmarking.

reading_caveat.zh: 已阅读全文及附录 A–F。实验针对二值无向经济金融网络的缺失边恢复，不等于未来边预测或对所有机器学习方法的结论。推荐为 AI 编辑意见，未独立复现实验。
reading_caveat.en: Full text and Appendices A-F were read. Experiments concern missing-edge recovery in binary undirected economic and financial networks, not future-link prediction or all machine-learning methods. This is AI editorial guidance; experiments were not independently reproduced.

question.zh: 为什么有些成果会沉睡多年后突然被发现？
question.en: Why are some works discovered only after years of obscurity?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把引文网络中的“遗忘”与“延迟认可”放进同一个生成模型：社区在知识空间中的移动，既可能远离旧成果，也可能重新接近被忽视的成果。对研究网络增长的人，这提供了一个可检验的机制视角。
值得借用的研究步骤是：跨系统寻找共同模式，用生成模型同时解释多个现象，再检查模型在哪些指标和条件下有效。它提醒我们，预测优势与机制解释需要分别验证。
en: Today’s pick puts aging and delayed recognition into one generative model: communities moving through knowledge space can leave older work behind or approach overlooked work. This offers a testable mechanism for researchers studying network growth.

Borrow its workflow: compare patterns across systems, explain several phenomena with one generative model, and inspect the metrics and conditions under which it works. Predictive gains and mechanistic explanations need separate checks.

heading.zh: 从社区变化解释节点命运

text.zh: 相似性、累积优势与适应度共同决定引用；不显式加入老化项，也能生成一定的衰退和再发现。
text.en: Relevance, cumulative advantage and fitness shape citations; some aging and rediscovery emerge without an explicit aging term.

heading.zh: 同时检验多种统计模式

text.zh: 比较科学、法律和专利的度分布、优先连接与“睡美人”现象，检验机制能否跨系统成立。
text.en: Compare degree distributions, preferential attachment and sleeping beauties across science, law and patents to test transfer across systems.

text.zh: 时间切分后比较误差与高被引识别；实验给定未来实际出版量和参考文献数，不能当作完全未知未来的预测。
text.en: Compare temporal prediction errors and high-impact retrieval; future publication and reference counts are given, so forecasting is conditional.

audience.zh: 网络生成模型、科学学与时序网络研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network growth, science of science and temporal networks.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读15页官方在线先行全文及方法，未读补充材料。跨系统统计一致不证明唯一因果机制，图4的预测优势也依赖系统与指标。本文尚待最终编辑；推荐为 AI 编辑意见，未独立复现。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 15-page publisher Article in Press and Methods; supplements were not read. Shared patterns do not establish a unique causal mechanism, and Figure 4 gains depend on system and metric. Final editing is pending. AI editorial guidance; no independent reproduction.

fulltext_review.title: Contagion-preserving compression for multiscale epidemic modeling
fulltext_review.version: Science Advances 12, eadz4710 (2026), publisher Version of Record, published 2026-10-09

question.zh: 网络缩小之后，哪些传播规律还能保留下来？
question.en: Which contagion properties survive when a network is compressed?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把网络压缩与传播机制直接联系起来：密集团何时可作为传播单元，合并后的边又该如何传递感染？这让粗粒化的选择有了可检查的动力学依据。
值得带走的是一套验证步骤：同时检查疫情规模、节点感染风险与传播时间，再按误差容忍度选择压缩尺度。做大网络模拟或干预设计时，这比只比较最终规模更有参考价值。
en: Today’s pick ties network compression to contagion mechanisms: when can a dense clique act as one spreading unit, and how should merged edges transmit infection? These questions give coarse-graining a checkable dynamical basis.

Borrow its validation workflow: compare outbreak size, node-level risk and timing, then choose compression scales under an error tolerance. This is useful for large-network simulation and intervention design.

heading.zh: 从传播机制定义粗粒化

text.zh: 检查块内感染是否近饱和，并按原始跨块边数合成传播概率，而非直接沿用原网络的感染率。
text.en: Check near-saturation within blocks and aggregate transmission probabilities using original interblock edges, rather than reusing the original rate.

text.zh: 同时比较总规模与节点风险；时间轨迹另需全局对齐，不能把对齐后的吻合视为原始时间完全一致。
text.en: Compare aggregate size and node-level risk; trajectories require global time alignment, which is not identity in unshifted time.

text.zh: 先在粗粒化网络定位关键区域，再映回原节点或边，减少播种冗余并针对跨组传播通道。
text.en: Locate regions on the reduced network, then map back to original nodes or edges to limit redundant seeds and target intergroup channels.

audience.zh: 网络传播、粗粒化、影响力最大化与干预设计研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in contagion, coarse-graining, influence maximization and network intervention.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读17页官方PDF，未读另附补充材料。核心理论针对静态无向SIR及确定恢复；有限团在感染率小于1时仍有初始传播失败概率，不宜将近饱和或模拟吻合等同普遍严格无损。时间比较经过对齐。AI编辑意见，未独立复现。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 17-page publisher PDF, not separate supplements. Core theory uses static undirected SIR with deterministic recovery. Finite cliques below unit transmission retain seed-extinction risk; near-saturation or simulated agreement is not universal exactness. Timing comparisons are aligned. AI editorial guidance; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 发现的平衡结构，来自数据还是算法的预设？
question.en: Does a balanced partition come from the data or the algorithm’s assumptions?

zh: 今天回选它，因为它提出一个直接影响网络分析结论的问题：如果算法本来就在寻找平衡分组，找到平衡能否算作理论证据？论文用18类群组关系和24个实证网络，让常被忽略的不平衡组织显现。
值得复用的是检验顺序：先检查方法预设，再比较带符号与无符号模型，最后分别评估三角形和群组尺度。它提醒我们，漂亮的分组结果也需要对照与不确定性。
en: Today’s archive pick asks a consequential question: if an algorithm seeks balanced groups, does finding them support balance theory? Its 18 pairwise relationship types and 24 empirical networks expose overlooked unbalanced organization.

Borrow the sequence: inspect methodological assumptions, compare signed and unsigned models, then assess triangles and groups separately. An appealing partition still needs controls and uncertainty checks.

text.zh: 对照平衡导向方法与度修正SBM，用已知分组的合成网络检验结果是否被目标函数牵引。
text.en: Contrast balance-oriented methods with degree-corrected SBMs, using synthetic networks with known groups to test objective-driven conclusions.

text.zh: 比较带符号模型与“无符号拓扑＋独立符号”基线的描述长度，不默认正负标签一定改善分组。
text.en: Compare description lengths against an unsigned-topology plus independent-sign baseline; do not assume signs necessarily improve grouping.

text.zh: 同时检查三角形平衡与群组挫折度；保留介观结构的零模型，再报告分组和关系类型的不确定性。
text.en: Check triadic balance and group-level frustration separately, use block-preserving null models, and report partition and type uncertainty.

audience.zh: 有符号网络、社区发现、社会平衡及实证网络研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in signed networks, community detection, social balance and empirical network analysis.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读15页官方PDF，未读另附补充材料。实证比较采用最大连通分量、无向化及二值化；关系类型依赖分组和模型，部分案例存在替代分组。结构解释不等于因果或传播验证。AI编辑意见，未独立复现。

Types depend on partitions and models; some cases admit alternatives. Structural interpretations are not causal or diffusion tests. AI editorial guidance; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 网络出现记忆，是单元的性质，还是耦合的结果？
question.en: Does network memory come from its elements or their coupling?

zh: 今天回选它，因为一个可调旁路就能把独立的迟滞单元变成相互作用网络，清楚展示局部形变如何经全局流量约束改变集体切换。它让“耦合从何而来”成为可以控制和检验的问题。
值得借鉴的是它的证据分层：先建立单元与无耦合基线，再比较状态切换路径和平均响应。尤其要注意，平均曲线越出原包络时，测试中的完整状态仍能恢复；不同的记忆判据不能互相替代。
en: Today’s archive pick uses a tunable bypass to turn independent hysterons into an interacting network. Local deformation changes collective switching through a global flow constraint, making the origin of coupling experimentally testable.

Borrow its layered checks: establish the element and uncoupled baseline, then compare state paths with average responses. Crossing the original envelope coexists with full-state recovery in tested protocols; different memory criteria are not interchangeable.

text.zh: 用流量与压差平衡解释远处单元为何相互影响，不把物理距离或直接接触当作唯一连接依据。
text.en: Use flow and pressure balance to explain distant interactions; physical proximity or contact need not define the effective coupling.

text.zh: 固定总流量时，无旁路串联单元可独立；固定总压差时则未必。对照必须和驱动方式一起定义。
text.en: Series elements can be independent without a bypass under fixed flow, but not necessarily under fixed pressure. Define the baseline with the drive.

heading.zh: 完整状态核验平均读数

text.zh: 结合切换图与状态向量区分反向切换、包络越界和回返点恢复，避免一条平均曲线承担多个结论。
text.en: Combine transition graphs and state vectors to distinguish counterswitching, envelope crossing and return-point recovery; one average curve cannot establish all three.

audience.zh: 网络动力学、集体记忆、流动网络与软物质研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network dynamics, collective memory, flow networks and soft matter.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读11页官方全文，未读独立补充材料和视频。结论基于低雷诺数、准静态流量驱动及有限阵列；复杂拓扑是后续方向。所测回返点均恢复，不能声称严格回返点记忆失效。AI编辑意见，未独立复现。
reading_caveat.en: Read the 11-page publisher article, not separate supplements or movies. Results concern low-Reynolds-number, quasistatic flow driving and finite arrays; complex topologies remain future work. Tested return points recover, so strict return-point memory failure is not established. AI editorial guidance; no independent reproduction.

question.zh: 拿不到完整流量，怎样重建一张可用的网络？
question.en: How can aggregate flows reconstruct a useful network?

zh: 今天选它，因为它直面网络研究常见的资料瓶颈：只有节点总量和区域信息，怎样生成可用于传播分析的稀疏加权网络？航空案例把约束选择、模型构造和任务检验连成一条清晰路径。
最值得复用的是分层验证：匹配已有约束之后，还要检查连接、空间模式和传播曲线。开放数据实验也提醒我们，先交代校准信息，再讨论重建效果。
en: Today’s pick addresses a recurring bottleneck: reconstructing a sparse weighted network from aggregate location and regional flows. Its aviation case connects constraint selection, model construction and epidemic-task validation.

Borrow the layered checks: after matching imposed constraints, test links, spatial patterns and spreading curves. The open-data experiment also makes it essential to state which calibration information remains available.

text.zh: 区分直接航班与实际起终点出行，避免把中转枢纽的流量当作最终人口混合。
text.en: Distinguish flight legs from origin-to-final-destination trips; transit-hub traffic need not represent population mixing.

text.zh: 先生成稀疏连接，再分配流量；节点强度与区域约束各自承担明确的模型角色。
text.en: Sample sparse links before assigning flows, giving location strengths and regional constraints explicit modeling roles.

text.zh: 对照真实网络上的传播峰值与空间分布，并将误差和随机模拟的自身波动比较。
text.en: Compare epidemic peaks and spatial patterns against the empirical network, using intrinsic simulation variability as a baseline.

zh: 今天选它，因为复杂时间统计未必需要先假定复杂记忆：节点只在高、低活跃间切换，群体层面就能出现更长的事件间隔尾部和缓慢自相关。这个从微观机制推到可观测量的过程很适合作为建模起点。
可借用的思路是先建立可解析的最小基线，再同时检查事件率、间隔变异系数和自相关，并按群体规模分层。多项趋势相似仍不意味着已经识别真实生成规则。
en: This paper makes a useful modeling point: complex event statistics need not begin with complex memory. Nodes switching between high and low activity can already yield longer event-time tails and slowly decaying autocorrelation at group level.
Borrow its minimal analytic baseline, then check event rates, interval variability and autocorrelation together across group sizes. Similar trends do not identify the true generating rule.

text.zh: 比较全员高活跃的 AND 规则与按活跃比例变化的 LIN 规则，明确群体事件如何产生。
text.en: Compare an all-members-high AND rule with a high-state-fraction LIN rule to make event generation explicit.

heading.zh: 用多个统计量约束模型

text.zh: 联合看事件率、间隔变异系数和自相关，减少单一长尾图带来的机制误判。
text.en: Combine event rates, interval variability and autocorrelation instead of inferring mechanisms from one tail plot.

text.zh: 实证比较是定性检验；允许参数随群体规模变化时，不同规则可给出相似趋势。
text.en: Empirical checks are qualitative; different rules can resemble each other when rates vary with group size.

audience.zh: 时间网络、高阶互动、事件序列建模及传播动力学研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in temporal networks, higher-order interactions, event sequences and spreading dynamics.

question.zh: 关系不断切换时，什么结构能让合作更容易演化？
question.en: Which changing network structures make cooperation easier to evolve?

zh: 选它是因为它提供了一个可复用的拆解方式：先固定网络切换、更新规则和突变设置，把它们的影响写成三个结构系数，再比较不同收益矩阵。对要扫描多种博弈的研究，这比每次重新展开整套模型更有启发。
另一点值得借用的是对照设计：用同构静态网络的不同节点配置隔离时间变化的作用，再扫描切换速度。动态核周结构提示，结构优势在人之间轮换也能影响合作；不能只看静态中心性或一张聚合图。
en: This paper offers a reusable decomposition: fix network switching, updating and mutation, encode their effects in three structure coefficients, then compare payoff matrices. That separation is especially useful when studying several games under one temporal-network mechanism.

Borrow its control design as well: compare isomorphic static configurations to isolate temporality, then scan switching rates. Rotating access to core positions can change cooperation, so static centrality or one aggregate graph may miss the mechanism.

text.zh: 弱选择下以三个系数组织网络、更新与突变影响，便于比较多种博弈。
text.en: Under weak selection, three coefficients organize network, update and mutation effects for comparisons across games.

text.zh: 用同构静态配置和切换速度扫描，区分结构本身与结构轮换的贡献。
text.en: Use isomorphic static controls and switching-rate scans to separate structure from its temporal rotation.

text.zh: 系数来自中性两、三节点概率等线性系统，模型压缩不等于常数计算成本。
text.en: Coefficients require neutral two- and three-node probability systems; a compact theorem does not imply constant computational cost.

question.zh: 未来驱动的路径互动，怎样自发形成周期与无序共存？
question.en: How can future-driven path interactions self-organize periodic and unstructured motion?

zh: 今天选它，因为论文把网络上的路径互动与共享出行联系起来：车辆不是回避走过的历史，而是在分配请求时相互避让计划中的未来轨迹。周期路线和无序路线因此可以在同一系统中共存。
可借用的分析顺序是先用边使用率检验单路线结构，再用加权复现图识别周期性，最后用环网络上的方向改变概率建立近似。这样能把“看起来有规律”拆成结构指标、动力学状态和机制解释。
en: I recommend this paper because it connects network path interactions with shared mobility: routes avoid one another’s planned futures during request assignment, allowing periodic and unstructured routes to coexist in one system.

A reusable workflow is to test single-route structure with link usage, detect periodicity with value-weighted recurrence plots, and then build a direction-change approximation on a ring. It separates visual regularity, dynamical state and mechanism.

heading.zh: 把路径互动写成网络动力学
heading.en: Model path interactions as network dynamics

text.zh: 未来轨迹的相互避让把请求分配、路线记忆和网络拓扑连在一起，适合研究非振荡个体如何出现集体结构。
text.en: Future-trajectory avoidance links request assignment, route memory and topology, offering a way to study collective structure without intrinsically oscillatory units.

heading.zh: 用复现图区分周期与无序

text.zh: 加权复现矩阵保留重复节点的身份，平均对角线长度再给出路线周期性比例，比只看时间序列更容易定位结构。
text.en: A value-weighted recurrence matrix keeps recurring node identities, while mean diagonal length quantifies periodicity more directly than a time series alone.

text.zh: 环网络上的方向改变概率准确抓住转变位置，但高估转变陡峭度，提醒我们把近似的趋势和精确预测分开报告。
text.en: The ring approximation captures the transition location but overestimates its sharpness, a useful reminder to report trends separately from exact prediction.

audience.zh: 网络动力学、路径规划、时间网络与共享出行建模研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in network dynamics, routing, temporal networks and shared-mobility modeling.

A reusable design is to ablate node attributes, prior edges and sparse supervision separately, then test transfer across unseen cell types and datasets. The evidence is computational benchmarking plus biological interpretation; it does not replace experimental validation.

text.en: Remove attributes, prior edges, directional attention and pruning separately to track their effects on performance and interpretation.

text.en: Test unseen cell types and cross-dataset transfer without fine-tuning to ask whether learned regulatory patterns travel.

question.zh: 局部旱灾或政策变化，如何经市场和运输网络改变远处群体的粮食安全？

question.zh: 活动依赖门控如何改变联想记忆网络的容量、稳定性与吸引子几何？
question.en: How does activity-dependent gating change capacity, stability and attractor geometry in associative-memory networks?

zh: 这篇文章把神经调制抽象为乘性门控，展示门控如何把过载网络中的短暂高重叠状态稳定下来，并让最终检索状态连续依赖初始线索。
可复用的方法是将多体模拟与动力学平均场理论相互校验，再用固定随机实现、只改变初始状态的二维流图检查多稳态；但有限斜率门控主要是长寿命状态，二值极限才是永久稳定。
en: The paper models neuromodulation as multiplicative gating and shows how it stabilizes high-overlap transients in overloaded networks, with final retrieval varying continuously with the initial cue.

A useful workflow is to cross-check many-body simulations with dynamical mean-field theory, then hold disorder fixed while varying only the initial state to test multistability. At finite gate slope the states are long-lived; permanence is an idealized binary-limit result.

text.zh: 门控在超过经典容量的区域保持量级为一的检索重叠，绕开无门控网络的灾难性失忆。
text.en: Gating preserves order-one retrieval beyond the classical capacity where the ungated network loses memory.

text.zh: 关闭子群冻结并稳定活跃神经元，解释了短暂吸引子为何可被保留。
text.en: A dynamically selected closed subpopulation stabilizes active neurons and preserves otherwise transient attractor structure.

text.zh: 固定网络实现并只改变初始状态的流图显示，门控网络可形成连续的稳定固定点云。
text.en: Flow diagrams with fixed disorder and varied initial states show a continuous cloud of stable fixed points.

audience.zh: 研究联想记忆、递归网络、网络动力学和神经形态计算的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying associative memory, recurrent networks, network dynamics and neuromorphic computing.

Finite gate slopes yield long-lived rather than permanent states; the model uses fully connected Hebbian couplings and random gate couplings, so biological applicability still needs structured connectivity data.

question.zh: 如何在控制活跃度与层密度后，区分多层社会网络中的主动联系分配与他人依赖？
question.en: How can we distinguish outgoing social effort from incoming reliance across relationship layers while accounting for activity and layer density?

zh: 今天选它，因为它把“联系有多少”和“联系分配到哪一层”分开，让多层社会角色的估计对象更明确。
值得借鉴的是同一数据下比较出向与入向角色，再用组成坐标、人口属性和地理关联检验差异。横截面年龄组差异不能直接解释为个体生命周期变化。
en: This paper separates how much people interact from how they distribute interactions across layers, making the role estimand explicit.

A useful workflow compares outgoing and incoming roles on the same data, then checks compositional coordinates, demographic associations and geography. Cross-sectional age-group differences do not establish individual life-course trajectories.

text.zh: 发送者、接收者与层密度效应吸收联系量差异；单纯形因子刻画相对层分配，避免把活跃度当作角色。

question.zh: 群体内决策相关性如何改变超图级联，而不改变起始阈值？

en: The useful lesson is the control: hold each group size's mean target activation fixed while changing outcome correlations, then test why identical onset can coexist with different survival.
A transfer matrix supplies the full offspring law; collision-matched, size and cutoff checks probe finite-network effects. Treat onset, survival and final size as separate observables.

text.zh: 独立对照与顺序规则保持各群体规模的目标边际及平均后代数一致。三均匀超图的生成函数比较证明存活率排序，更大群体仅有数值扫描支持。

text.zh: 后代均值决定分枝起始，完整生成函数决定灭绝概率。独立对照的平均最终规模还需前向存活与反向可达性之积；顺序规则未给出相应精确闭合。
text.en: The offspring mean sets branching onset; the full generating function sets extinction. Null mean final size requires forward survival times backward reachability; no analogous exact closure is derived for the sequential rule.

heading.zh: 用尺寸变化辨认振荡来源
heading.en: Use size variation to identify oscillations

text.zh: 振幅随系统规模衰减、重标度谱塌缩、频率和相位差近似不变共同支持噪声驱动准周期；局部线性参考并未精确预测全部频率。
text.en: Decaying amplitude, collapsed rescaled spectra and nearly size-independent frequency and phase jointly support noise-driven quasi-cycles. The local linear reference does not predict every frequency quantitatively.

heading.zh: 把救援和风险传播放在同一守恒关系中
heading.en: Put rescue and risk propagation in one balance

text.zh: 层间交换补充受损层，也降低完好层资源。配对损伤与无损伤对照帮助区分损伤引发的级联和系统自身失稳；前沿及级联边界依赖具体协议。
text.en: Exchange replenishes a damaged layer while lowering resources in an intact one. Paired damage controls distinguish a damage-led cascade from intrinsic instability; front and cascade boundaries depend on the protocol.

audience.zh: 研究演化博弈、生态—社会反馈、多层网络韧性、噪声与空间传播的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying evolutionary games, eco-social feedback, multilayer resilience, noise and spatial propagation.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读正式PDF全部16页（含封面），正文I–VI、表I、图1–8、附录A–D和参考文献表，并核对关键图表。未完整审读补充材料。判据限于无突变的可微未截断内部平衡点；空间阈值依赖种子、截断、参数与观察窗，累积收益使拓扑效应与度依赖选择混合。未独立复现。
reading_caveat.en: Read all 16 publisher PDF pages including cover, Sections I-VI, Table I, Figures 1-8, Appendices A-D and reference list; checked key rendered figures. Supplementary material was not fully reviewed. The criterion concerns mutation-free differentiable unclipped interior equilibria; spatial thresholds depend on seeds, cutoffs, parameters and observation windows, while cumulative payoffs mix topology with degree-dependent selection. No independent reproduction.

fulltext_review.title: Redundancy maximization as a principle of associative memory learning in Hopfield networks
fulltext_review.version: Publisher Version of Record, Nature Communications 17, 11499 (2026)
fulltext_review.read_scope: All 8 publisher PDF pages, Results, Discussion, Methods, Figures 1-6/captions, equations 1-8, data/code availability and reference list/declarations. Rendered PDF pages 3-6 visually checked (PID profiles, goal landscape, capacity/stability and method equations). Supplementary Notes, cited papers, source code and simulations not independently reviewed or reproduced.

question.zh: 局部冗余信息，如何变成循环网络的联想记忆？
question.en: How does local redundant information become associative memory in a recurrent network?

zh: 今天选它，因为论文把信息分解从事后分析推进到可训练的局部目标：先问每个神经元的循环输入是否编码了目标相关信息，再观察整个网络能否维持记忆。
值得借鉴的是同时检查目标函数、测试信息边界和回忆指标。平均存储容量、完整模式回忆率与抗噪稳定性回答不同问题，不能用一个提升数字替代全部表现。
en: This pick turns information decomposition from a diagnostic into a trainable local goal: ask whether recurrent input carries target-relevant information, then test whether the whole network maintains memories.

Borrow its separate checks of objectives, test-time information and recall metrics. Mean storage capacity, complete-pattern recall and noise tolerance answer different questions; one improvement does not establish every form of robustness.

heading.zh: 教学信号与测试动力学分开

text.zh: 目标输入只参与训练，测试依赖循环输入。局部冗余把“任务相关”与“已编码在循环连接中”联系起来，便于解释网络何时失去记忆。
text.en: The target input is used for training; testing relies on recurrent input. Local redundancy links task relevance with information encoded by recurrent connections, helping interpret memory failure.

heading.zh: 比较信息目标，而非只比较算法名

text.zh: 目标互信息也能获得接近的容量，但超容量后可由目标独有信息维持高值。PID揭示这一差别；纯冗余1.59与混合目标约1.70须分别说明。
text.en: Target mutual information achieves similar capacity but can stay high beyond capacity through target-unique information. PID exposes that distinction; pure redundancy at 1.59 and optimized mixed goals near 1.70 must be reported separately.

heading.zh: 容量不等于吸引域稳定性

text.zh: 图6另测受损初态的回忆稳定性；负载约0.8以上，各比较方法的抗噪余量都接近零。读取平均余弦相似度、阈值回忆率和噪声曲线，才能正确理解容量提升。
text.en: Figure 6 separately tests corrupted initial states: above a load near 0.8, noise tolerance approaches zero across the compared methods. Read mean cosine accuracy, threshold recall and corruption curves together to interpret capacity gains.

audience.zh: 研究循环网络、联想记忆、网络集体计算与信息论学习目标的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying recurrent networks, associative memory, collective computation and information-theoretic learning objectives.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读正式PDF全部8页及图1–6、方法和参考文献表，渲染核对第3–6页。主实验为100神经元的双极性模式，20次初始化；Hebb分析另用500神经元。联合概率估计成本较高，目标权重与规模依赖尚未厘清；未完整审读补充材料或独立复现，不推及任意网络与生物学习。
reading_caveat.en: Read all 8 publisher PDF pages, Figures 1-6, Methods and reference list; visually checked pages 3-6. Main tests use 100 neurons and bipolar patterns across 20 initializations; Hebbian analysis also uses 500 neurons. Joint-probability estimation is costly and target-scale versus network-size effects remain open. Supplementary material was not fully reviewed; no independent reproduction or generalization to arbitrary networks and biological learning.

fulltext_review.title: Explosive connectivity and mechanical rigidity in cubic lattice structures
fulltext_review.version: Publisher Version of Record, Physical Review Research 8,043134 (2026)
fulltext_review.read_scope: All 15 publisher PDF pages: Sections I-V, definitions, equations and conditional derivations, Figures 1-7/captions, discussion, declarations and full reference list. Rendered pages 7 and 10 visually checked. Supplementary proofs/tables/videos and code not independently reviewed or reproduced. Connectivity reaches L=192; rigidity uses a relaxed 3D pebble-game proxy through L=10. Theorem 1 is conditional; finite-size sharpness alone does not establish a thermodynamic discontinuity.

question.zh: 连通与刚化之间，为什么还差一段加边过程？
question.en: Why does a connected lattice still need more bonds to become rigid?

zh: 今天从馆藏回选这篇，因为巨型连通簇的出现与机械约束的建立是两个不同的集体过程。把两条转变曲线并排，能看到只优化连通性时容易忽略的结构余量。
值得借鉴的是把选边规则、有限尺寸现象与刚性判据分开检查。增加候选边数量并不保证全局刚化收益一直提高；还要区分条件理论、组合代理量和严格的三维刚性。
en: This archive pick separates the appearance of a giant connected cluster from the buildup of mechanical constraints. Reading both transition curves exposes the structural gap that connectivity alone can hide.

Borrow its separate checks of edge-selection rules, finite-size behavior and rigidity criteria. More candidate edges need not keep improving global rigidification; conditional theory, combinatorial proxies and exact 3D rigidity must remain distinct.

heading.zh: 连通并不等于机械稳定

text.zh: 比较仅含轴向边的NN格点与加入面、体对角线的Intra宿主，结合巨型簇和刚化曲线讨论两种阈值之间的加边间隔。
text.en: Compare the axis-edge NN lattice with the Intra host containing face and body diagonals, then read giant-component and rigidification curves together to study the bond-density gap.

heading.zh: 选择更多，收益可能非单调
heading.en: More choice can have nonmonotonic benefits

text.zh: 乘积规则延迟连通，但正文报告Intra刚化间隔在中等选择数附近达到最小，较大选择数形成更树状的柔性簇。局部选边目标与全局机械目标需要分别评估。
text.en: The product rule delays connectivity, but the main text reports a minimum Intra rigidity gap at intermediate choice, with larger choice creating more treelike floppy clusters. Evaluate edge-selection and mechanical objectives separately.

heading.zh: 让计算尺度与判据一起出现

text.zh: 连通性模拟达到L=192，刚性分析只到L=10并使用松弛三维pebble-game代理；定理1依赖尚待证明的假设。有限尺寸陡跃不能单独证明热力学极限不连续。
text.en: Connectivity simulations reach L=192, while rigidity uses a relaxed 3D pebble-game proxy only through L=10. Theorem 1 depends on unproved assumptions; sharp finite-size jumps alone do not prove a discontinuous thermodynamic limit.

audience.zh: 研究渗流、网络生成、刚性转变与机械网络设计，或需要区分有限尺寸证据和理论假设的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying percolation, network growth, rigidity transitions and mechanical-network design, especially those separating finite-size evidence from theoretical assumptions.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读正式PDF全部15页、图1–7、推导、讨论及参考文献表，并渲染核对第7和10页。刚性结果采用松弛组合代理，不能等同精确三维通用刚性或真实材料刚度；连通性的大尺度结果不可冒充同尺度刚性结果。局部进展定理有条件，补充证明、表格、视频与代码未独立审读或复现。
reading_caveat.en: Read all 15 publisher PDF pages, Figures 1-7, derivations, discussion and reference list; visually checked pages 7 and 10. Relaxed combinatorial rigidity is not exact generic 3D rigidity or material stiffness; large-scale connectivity results do not establish rigidity at that scale. The local-progress theorem is conditional. Supplementary proofs/tables/videos and code were not independently reviewed or reproduced.

fulltext_review.title: How interaction radius shapes vortex states in mobile phase oscillators
fulltext_review.version: Physical Review Research 8, 043126 (2026), published 2026-11-04
fulltext_review.read_scope: Complete publisher main text Sections I–VII, Eqs. 1–43, captions and reference list; Figures 1–4 visually checked from rendered pages 4,5,6,10. Supplemental figures/data and code not read or reproduced.

question.zh: 同样的同步阈值，为何会出现不同的集体图案？
question.en: Why can the same onset threshold lead to different collective patterns?

zh: 今天回选这篇，是因为移动会不断改变谁与谁相连。相互作用半径既决定即时邻域，也影响局部旋转如何转成全局同向运动；把它作为控制变量，比只看平均同步强度更能揭示集体组织的差别。
建议把图案、时序和邻接矩阵一起读，再比较正反向扫参。文章也明确区分了线性失稳与非线性吸引子：前者的阈值相同，并不意味着后者的选择、稳定性和滞后也相同。
en: This archive pick treats motion as a process that continually changes who interacts with whom. Interaction radius shapes both instantaneous neighborhoods and the balance between local rotation and global alignment, making it useful beyond a single coherence statistic.

Read spatial patterns, order-parameter traces and adjacency matrices together, then compare forward and backward scans. The paper distinguishes linear onset from nonlinear attractors: an unchanged onset threshold does not determine state selection, vortex stability or hysteresis.

heading.zh: 观察图案，也观察相互作用网络
heading.en: Read the pattern and its interaction network

text.zh: 有限半径内的相位耦合随粒子位置演化。图1把空间快照、全局序参量与频率排序的邻接矩阵并列，显示涡旋与极化态对应的组织差别。
text.en: Finite-radius phase coupling evolves with particle positions. Figure 1 juxtaposes spatial snapshots, coherence traces and frequency-ordered adjacency matrices to distinguish vortex and polar organization.

heading.zh: 区分均匀模态与空间模态

text.zh: 在文中的连续体与低阶谐波近似下，归一化邻域平均保留均匀失稳阈值Kc(0)=2Δ；有限波数的阈值则依赖相互作用核和半径。这是理解局部耦合不能简单等同全局平均场的切入点。
text.en: Within the stated continuum and low-harmonic approximation, normalized neighborhood averaging preserves Kc(0)=2Δ, while finite-wave-number thresholds depend on interaction range. This separates local coupling from a global mean-field description.

heading.zh: 把线性解释停在适用边界内
heading.en: Keep the linear explanation within its scope

text.zh: 正反向扫描提供涡旋与极化态共存的数值证据。作者明确指出：无序态附近的线性谱与涡旋持存区间之间仍是启发性联系，定量稳定边界和滞后需要非线性分析。
text.en: Forward and backward scans provide numerical evidence of coexisting states. The authors explicitly keep the link between the incoherent-state spectrum and vortex persistence heuristic; quantitative stability and hysteresis require nonlinear analysis.

audience.zh: 研究移动相互作用网络、同步、手性活性物质及局部耦合建模的读者。
audience.en: Readers studying mobile interaction networks, synchronization, chiral active matter and local-coupling models.

reading_caveat.zh: 已读正式版13页正文、公式、图1–4及参考文献表，并渲染核对全部4张主图。适用范围是无噪声二维周期边界模型、洛伦兹频率分布及所测参数；线性分析使用均匀密度与低阶谐波截断。补充材料未独立审读，正文报告的尺寸检验不能冒充已复核的补充证据；未复现数值实验。线性失稳阈值不等同涡旋的非线性稳定边界。
reading_caveat.en: Read all 13 publisher pages, equations, Figures 1–4 and the reference list; visually checked all four main figures. Scope: noiseless 2D periodic model, Lorentzian frequencies and tested parameters; linear analysis assumes homogeneous density and truncates angular harmonics. The supplement was not independently read and simulations were not reproduced. Main-text reports of supplemental size scans are not independent verification. Linear onset is not a nonlinear vortex-stability boundary.

question.zh: 高阶行为的信号，能告诉我们真实作用发生在哪一阶吗？
question.en: Can a higher-order behavioral signal tell us the order of the underlying mechanism?

heading.zh: 学会设计机制关闭对照

text.zh: 关闭目标阶机制，保留其他阶作用，再检查信号是否消失。图 4 的对照能启发我们检验指标是否受到跨阶效应干扰。
text.en: Disable the target-order mechanism while retaining other orders, then check whether the signal disappears. Figure 4 suggests a control for cross-order interference.

heading.en: Match the measure to the task

text.zh: 将“检测到依赖”和“找对机制阶数”分开评估。图 5 中协同信息更能区分阶数，提醒我们按推断目标选择指标。
text.en: Evaluate dependence detection separately from correct mechanism-order identification. Synergy is more selective for order in Figure 5: choose measures for the inference task.

text.zh: 改变测量节点组的大小，比较相邻阶的响应。若更大的组仍有信号，就应检查指标能否定位具体阶数；迁移到自己的模型时也可沿用这一测试。
text.en: Vary measured group size and compare neighboring orders. If larger groups retain a signal, test whether the measure can locate the specific order. Reuse this check in your own model.

audience.zh: 高阶网络、传播动力学、信息论与网络推断研究者。
audience.en: Researchers in higher-order networks, contagion dynamics, information theory and network inference.

reading_caveat.zh: 依据用户提供的正式出版版 PDF（18 页）阅读全文，涵盖正文、附录 A–E 与图 1–13。推荐与可复用经验为 AI 编辑意见；结果限于文中测试的 SIS 与随机高阶网络，未独立复现实验。
reading_caveat.en: Based on a full reading of the user-provided publisher PDF (18 pages), including the main text, Appendices A-E and Figures 1-13. Recommendations and reusable lessons are AI editorial judgments. Findings apply to the tested SIS and random higher-order networks; experiments were not independently reproduced.

zh: 今天选它，因为它用 SIS 模型给出一个值得警惕的反例：某阶机制已关闭，该阶行为信号仍可能存在。
值得带走的是它的验证思路：用机制开关与跨阶比较，检验指标究竟识别了什么。做高阶网络推断时，这套对照值得借鉴。
en: Today's pick offers a revealing SIS counterexample: a signal can persist at an order whose mechanism has been disabled.

Take away its validation strategy: use mechanism switches and cross-order comparisons to test what a measure actually identifies. These controls are worth borrowing for higher-order network inference.
